caveat: The page is a stub with TODO notes and does not state that its list is complete; 84 buildings were listed in the read text. Tiers and run-feed effects are 'not listed' for most entries. Housing passives are 'not described' except where noted. Stat bonus buildings: +1 base, upgradeable to +5 at level 5; Captain's Quarters can add +1 more. Infinitely upgradeable buildings: +1 stat per level; build point cost caps at 1050. Read via summarising fetch.
